criteria.criterion: A raw hypha newline burst sent immediately after the shell-ready banner reaches the parser without a dropped byte or hang.
criteria.evidenceRef: The test observed the complete policy-denial diagnostic `shell: command not found: hypha`; a truncated command would produce a different token.

criteria.criterion: Peer death wakes a blocked sender with an error and makes it runnable.
criteria.evidenceRef: The boot selftest asserted Ready state, reply_value and trap return error sentinels, and exact sender presence in a hart-local ready queue.

criteria.criterion: Real cell death returns an error to a blocked sender and also covers ForceExit queued notification delivery.
criteria.evidenceRef: QEMU observed `[peer-death-runtime] PASS (blocked-send error + ForceExit notification)` after a heartbeat watchdog killed the busy peer.

criteria.criterion: RecvScatter remains isolated to owned mailbox delivery and is not silently converted to completion-queue behavior.
criteria.evidenceRef: The boot selftest used an invalid retained Recv pointer, required owned pending bytes, and asserted no completion queue was created.

criteria.criterion: Unsafe VFS foreign-grant copies remain documented as blocking-caller invariants before Phase 04.
criteria.evidenceRef: The audit lists ReadGrant and ReadFileGrant service-side copies and excludes fail-closed WriteGrant and caller-owned pre-share copy.
